visit.trail_note: No standing tower; the spur to South Peak is unmarked and the access road is unpaved

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the type as Open Tower, and the 1922 and 1925 Forest Lookouts notices call it a fire tower with an observer's cabin.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Early notices call the hill Dorset Mountain (1921) and Dorset Peak (1922). onX places the old tower site on South Peak, a short spur off the route, with the true summit about 0.5 mile northeast of it. A 2008 hiking account found tower remains on a height of land it first took for the lower of two peaks; it may be the same site, but no source confirms that.

notes_for_editor: Removal date and tower type are not in any source. The index coordinates (43.30925, -73.02823) may be for the true summit rather than the South Peak tower site; not verified. The proposed kind correction (platform to tower) rests on the Open Tower type; editor to confirm the enum. Hiking accounts are not agency records.
